rationale: Warren Buffett's retirement after six decades at Berkshire Hathaway marks a significant shift in US financial markets; Japan's rate hike signals continued global monetary tightening affecting US economic conditions; Pakistan mosque attack with 21 dead represents ongoing regional instability.

top_events.title: Warren Buffett steps down after six decades at Berkshire - 'Father Time always wins'
top_events.label: Warren Buffett steps down after six decades
top_events.summary: Legendary investor Warren Buffett retires from Berkshire Hathaway after 60 years, marking end of an era for US financial markets and the conglomerate he built from a textile mill.

top_events.title: Japan raises interest rate to new 31-year high to curb rising prices
top_events.label: Japan raises rates to 31-year high
top_events.summary: Japan's rate hike to highest level in 31 years reflects global central bank tightening trend, indirectly affecting US credit markets and economic conditions.

top_events.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
top_events.label: Explosives-laden vehicle rams Pakistan mosque kills 21
top_events.summary: Vehicle bomb attack on Pakistan mosque kills at least 21 including a four-year-old child, with gunmen also opening fire on police facility in ongoing regional instability.
